countries.description: List of countries to retrieve OSM data for

crs.description:
Coordinate reference systems, matching PyPSA-Earth's config.default.yaml
``crs:`` section exactly (key names and defaults).

geo_crs.description: General geographic projection, not used for metric measures. "EPSG:4326" is the standard used by OSM and google maps

distance_crs.description: Projection for distance measurements only. Possible recommended values are "EPSG:3857" (used by OSM and Google Maps)

features.description: OSM features to retrieve for each country

force_redownload.description: Force refresh of cached data in earth-osm

cache_primary.description: Enable caching of primary feature data in earth-osm

target_date.description: Optional historical date for data retrieval in ISO 8601 datetime format

retrieve.description: Configuration for OSM data retrieval using earth-osm

tag_substation.description: Only keep substations whose OSM substation tag matches this value (matches PyPSA-Earth's clean_osm_data.py config key of the same name); empty string disables the filter

country_assignment.description: Method to assign country to each asset; 'gadm_shape' requires country/offshore shapefiles as additional input and is more robust near borders

detect_converters.description: Detect DC converters/switching substations from OSM tags

dedupe_cross_border.description: Remove duplicate lines/relations spanning country borders (the clean_osm rule processes every configured country at once, so this comparison happens automatically as part of that single rule)

hvdc_routes.description: Parse Overpass route relations for multi-way HVDC links; only meaningful when retrieve.source is 'overpass'

add_line_endings.description: Create synthetic substation stubs at dangling line endpoints

mode.description: Whether to keep or drop under-construction assets

remove_after.description: Only remove under-construction assets started after this date; has no effect when mode is 'keep'

generators.description: Optional generator-extraction module (ported from PyPSA-Earth, absent in PyPSA-Eur).

enabled.description: Extract power generators from OSM data

name_method.description: Method for naming generators lacking an OSM name tag; 'closest_city' uses the reverse_geocode package (already part of PyPSA-Earth's own environment)

additionalProperties.description:
Per-asset override to splice in non-OSM data, generalizing PyPSA-Earth's
use_custom_{lines,cables,substations} mechanism to every asset type.

mode.description: How to combine OSM data with user-supplied custom data for this asset

path.description: Path to custom data file, required unless mode is 'osm_only'

stage.description: 'pre_clean' splices custom data into OSM-shaped rows before cleaning/clustering runs (PyPSA-Earth's original use case: hand-edited fixups). 'post_build' accepts an already-final component table and skips clean/build_network entirely for this asset (e.g. a pre-built dataset such as PyPSA-Eur's tyndp/entsoegridkit sources).

custom_data.description: Per-asset custom/non-OSM data overrides, keyed by asset name

clean.description: Configuration for cleaning raw OSM data into canonical component tables

group_tolerance_buses.description: Distance (m) within which nearby buses are merged into one station. No default: PyPSA-Earth (coarse OSM coverage) and PyPSA-Eur (dense coverage) disagree by an order of magnitude (5000 vs 500), so every consumer must set this explicitly rather than inherit a value tuned for the other repo.

overpassing_lines_tolerance.description: Snap tolerance (m) for splitting overpassing lines

split_overpassing_lines.description: Split lines that geometrically cross other lines without a shared node

force_ac.description: Force all lines to be treated as AC

voltage_group_split.description: If set, split a bus cluster into separate stations when the relative spread of voltages within it exceeds this fraction (optional refinement on top of distance-based clustering)

build_network.description: Configuration for building final network topology from cleaned OSM data
